svg.title: Uniform Gamma at three supplied H-rate interval radii

g.text: Uniform Gamma: three supplied H-only rate boxes
Fixed center 1; radii 0, 1/2, 1. Other five rates zero; unchanged physical metric.
Three exact computed bounds; no general monotonicity claim. Display values are approximate.
Source: unchanged metric / Q polynomial; RESULTS.json stores exact rational outward bounds.
